We’re Your HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, and Indoor Air Quality Experts – Chesapeake, VA!

Russell’s and American Mechanical offers prompt, reliable, and courteous service for homes and businesses throughout the Hampton Roads area. Our experienced and superbly trained team can diagnose, repair, install, and maintain just about any heating, cooling, plumbing, and electrical component in your home, including 24/7 emergency service. From traditional to high-tech, we can keep your home cozy and comfortable all year long.

We service the entire Hampton Roads, Virginia, area, including Virginia Beach, Chesapeake, Norfolk, Williamsburg, Portsmouth, Suffolk, and Yorktown. In North Carolina, we serve the communities of Moyock, South Mills, Elizabeth City, as well as much of the surrounding areas.

Total Home Comfort Solutions – Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & More!
Same-day Service or It’s Free!

Experience ultimate home comfort with our expert services for heating, cooling, plumbing, indoor air quality, electrical, and attic insulation. We prioritize top-notch service for all your home’s essential systems.

  • Responsive Service

    Your satisfaction is our top priority. We go above and beyond to address your needs promptly and efficiently. Trust us for solid solutions and exceptional support. If we can’t reach your home the same day, we’ll waive the diagnostic fee.

  • Expert Technicians

    Our technicians are highly skilled and experienced in their respective fields. With attention to detail and a commitment to excellence, they deliver top-notch service and solutions.

  • Transparent Communication

    Our team ensures clear and open dialogue, keeping you informed every step of the way. Expect honesty, clarity, and integrity in all our interactions.

  • Quality Workmanship

    From installation to maintenance and repairs, we strive for excellence in every job we undertake. Your project is in capable hands with our unmatched workmanship.

Proudly Serving the Communities In & Around Hampton Roads for Nearly 50 Years

Russell’s American Mechanical proudly serves the entire Hampton Roads area in Virginia, encompassing major cities, such as Virginia Beach, Norfolk, and Chesapeake. We also service areas in North Carolina, such as Moyock and Elizabeth City.

With a legacy dating back to 1977, we’ve built a reputation for exceptional customer service and reliability. Our team of dedicated professionals, including customer service representatives, technicians, and installers, works tirelessly to ensure prompt responses and top-quality service.

Are you a commercial customer outside the Hampton Roads area? Give us a call, and we’ll see what we can do to set you up with our qualified technicians.
